## FAQ Knowledge Base (382 Q&As)

### Website development cost in India
URL: https://easypeezetech.com/faq/website-development-cost-india/
Q: How much does website development cost in India?
A: Focused 5 to 12 page business websites in India typically start around INR 25,000 to INR 75,000, while custom Next.js/React web apps or e-commerce stores range from INR 1.5 lakh upward depending on integrations, dashboards, and timelines. EasyPeeze Technologies shares a fixed-scope written quote after a short discovery call.
Q: What is included in a website development package?
A: Page structure, mobile-friendly layout, contact form, basic SEO setup, speed checks and a launch checklist.
Q: How long does a business website take?
A: Many 5 to 12 page sites finish in 2 to 6 weeks once content and approvals are ready. EasyPeeze Technologies delivers fixed milestones, weekly demos, and 100% source code and IP handover to your team.
Q: Do you build SEO-friendly websites?
A: Yes. Clean URLs, sitemap, schema where useful, and pages written for buyer questions, not just decoration.
Q: Can you redesign my existing website?
A: Yes. We audit speed, clarity and enquiry flow, then rebuild or improve without throwing away what already works.
Q: Is WordPress okay for a business website?
A: Sometimes. We recommend WordPress when your team needs frequent editorial updates. For product-heavy sites we often prefer a modern web stack.
Q: Do you write website content?
A: We can guide structure and headlines. Final business claims and legal copy stay with you unless content is scoped in.
Q: What pages should a service business website include?
A: Home, services, about, proof or process, FAQ, pricing guidance if you can share it, and contact.
Q: Will my website work on phones?
A: Yes. Mobile layout is part of every website development project. EasyPeeze Technologies delivers fixed milestones, weekly demos, and 100% source code and IP handover to your team.
Q: Do you provide hosting?
A: We can recommend and set up hosting. You keep ownership of the domain and accounts. EasyPeeze Technologies delivers fixed milestones, weekly demos, and 100% source code and IP handover to your team.
Q: What is the difference between a website and a landing page?
A: A website covers multiple offers and trust pages. A landing page focuses on one campaign or offer.
Q: Can a website generate leads?
A: Yes, if offers are clear, forms are easy, and pages answer buyer questions. That is how we scope lead-generation websites.

### SEO company India, AEO and GEO
URL: https://easypeezetech.com/faq/seo-company-india-aeo-geo/
Q: What does an SEO company in India do?
A: EasyPeeze Technologies improves your site so people find you on Google, then keeps content and technical health moving.
Q: How much is an SEO retainer in India?
A: Technical SEO, AEO, and GEO retainers in India are scoped around site size, content velocity, and competition, covering schema markup, llms.txt, programmatic topic hubs, Core Web Vitals, and Bing/Google indexing. Contact EasyPeeze Technologies for a fixed monthly or one-time audit quote.
Q: What is AEO?
A: Answer engine optimization: structuring content so search systems can use it as a short answer.
Q: What is GEO?
A: Generative engine optimization: making your brand easy for AI assistants to cite. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Do you offer technical SEO?
A: Yes: speed, indexation, sitemap, schema and crawl issues. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Is SEO only for big brands?
A: No. Clear service pages and steady content help small India businesses too. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: How long until SEO results?
A: Technical fixes can help sooner. Content and authority usually take months of consistent work. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Do you do local SEO?
A: Yes, including alignment with Google Business Profile where relevant. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Can SEO help ChatGPT mention my business?
A: GEO-style pages, FAQs and proof help AI systems find accurate facts about you. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Do you write SEO content?
A: We can plan clusters and write service or FAQ pages as part of retainers or projects. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: Should SEO start before website launch?
A: Yes when possible. Building discoverability into the site beats bolting SEO on later. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
Q: What is LLM SEO?
A: Content and structure aimed at large language model answers, closely related to GEO. EasyPeeze Technologies pairs clean HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, and Bing/Google indexing so pages are citable across traditional and AI search.
